# Trivy IaC exemptions for the shared security workflow (security / iac).
# id | path | expires (YYYY-MM-DD) | issue | reason
#
# Why these rows: they baseline the High and Critical findings that were on
# main when the check was turned on, so it can block new ones at once
# without failing every PR. Each row expires; fix the finding and delete
# its row (luthersystems/fabric-network-builder#22). A row for a finding kept on purpose
# needs a real reason, not the Trivy title.
DS-0002 | Dockerfile | 2027-01-31 | luthersystems/fabric-network-builder#28 | Deferred: callers mount the root-owned docker socket and pass --chown, which runs chown -R on the files the image writes; a USER change needs every caller to run it with --user and --group-add first, then a new release.
